name: interrelated-web
description: The control-plane dashboard: Next.js App Router on Vercel. Short request/response surfaces only - auth, org onboarding, provider setup, conversation/document lists. Long-lived streams and sockets live in realtime/ by design (Vercel functions cannot hold them open, and the split confines the newer framework to a CRUD surface where a bug is a bad page). On Next 16, not the plan's 15: Next 15's dependency chain carries high-severity npm advisories (postcss, sharp) whose fix is only in 16, and the App Router architecture the plan actually names is unchanged.
